name: Ray-Bounding Box Intersection and Sampling Preparation
definition: A CUDA-based pipeline to compute ray-bounding box intersections, determine the number of sample points per ray based on a fixed step distance, and generate query points along rays for volume rendering.
summary: This method computes ray-bounding box intersections and generates discretized 3D sample points, distinguishing itself by adding discretization logic and explicit bounding box culling to standard intersection routines.
